chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Consider our robot here that's interacting with the world.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: The first thing it sees is some state.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And as we've talked about already, the thing to do now is to take that state,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: go look in the q table, and find the action that corresponds to the maximum q value.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And then take that action.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Once that action is taken, that results in two new things.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: One is a new state, we call that s prime, and a reward.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: All that information comes into the robot and

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: it needs to use that information to update its q table.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So as a consequence of this interaction with the world,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: it's got an s, an a, an s prime, and an r.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: How does it take that information to improve this q table?

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: There are two main parts to the update rule.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: The first is, what is the old value that we used to have?

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And that's q s a.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And what is our improved estimate?

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And we want to blend them together.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And to combine them, we introduce this new variable alpha.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Alpha is the learning rate.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Alpha can take on any value from 0 to 1.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Usually we use about 0.2.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And what that means is, in our new improved version of q,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: which I indicate over here as q prime, it's a blend of alpha times the improved

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: estimate plus 1 minus alpha of the old value.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So larger values of alpha cause us to learn more quickly.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Lower values of alpha cause the learning to be more slow.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So a low value of alpha, for instance, means that in this update rule,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: the previous value for q of s a is more strongly preserved.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So stretching it out in a little bit more detail, again,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: we have here our current value for the q at s a plus alpha times the immediate reward,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: plus gamma times later rewards.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Now we're introducing gamma here.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So I promise there's only two new parameters here that you have to worry about.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: What gamma is, is the discount rate.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And similar to alpha, gamma usually ranges from 0 to 1.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: A low value of gamma means that we value later rewards less.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Remember the discount rate when we were talking about bonds?

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Same thing.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: A low value of gamma equates to essentially a high discount rate.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: A high value of gamma, in other words, a gamma near 1,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: means that we value later rewards very significantly.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: If we were to use 1.0, that means a reward 20 steps in the future is worth

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: just as much as a reward right now.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Now, we have to expand this component here in a little bit more detail.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: This next part here is a little bit tricky, but don't worry,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: we're going to step through it step by step.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: This component represents our future discounted rewards.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: In other words, we end up in state s prime, and from then on out,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: we're going to act optimally, or at least the best that we know how to.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And the question is, what is the value of those future rewards if we reach state s prime,

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: and we act appropriately?

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Well, it is simply that q value.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: But we have to find out what the action is that we would have taken so

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: that we can reference the q table properly.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, if we're in state s prime, the action that we would take that would maximize our

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: future reward is argmax a prime.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, a prime is that next action that we're going to take with regard to q s prime a prime.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, we're going to find that best a prime, that best action that maximizes the value

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: when we're in that state.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, this collapses just to a prime, and then we look up the q table value for q s prime a prime.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, that allows us to bring it all together now.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, our update rule is the following.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Our new q value in state s action a is that old value multiplied by 1 minus alpha.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: So, depending on how large alpha is, we value that old value more or less.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: Plus alpha times our new best estimate.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And our new best estimate is, again, our immediate reward plus the discounted reward

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: for all of our future actions.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: And that's it.

chunks.title: Update Rule
chunks.text: This is the equation you need to know to implement q learning.
